45 -> 42. odoo/tools reaches zero.

Three ValueErrors built their message with `_()` / `env._()`: one in convert.py
for a data file that failed to load, two in translate.py for an unrecognised
file format and extension. A ValueError raised out of the loader reaches a
reader as a traceback, never as UI, so the gettext call buys a catalogue entry
nobody reads and a lookup on a path that is already failing. All three are
f-strings now.
